'''Ashy''' was the name of a [[Rattataki/Legends|Rattataki]] male pilot in the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]]. Originally adopted by a pair of [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Imperial]] aristocrats, Ashy was named due to his [[Species/Legends|species]]' skin [[Color/Legends|color]], and made to believe he could join the [[Imperial Military (Sith Empire)|Imperial Military]], due to his adoptive parents' dressing him up as an Imperial officer at parties. When Ashy discovered that they simply found it amusing, and he would never be an Imperial soldier, he fled to the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and became a [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]].
